name: CSV import
summary: Validate an uploaded spreadsheet into Postgres with a row-level error report

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
env.description: Object Storage endpoint. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Object Storage access key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Object Storage secret key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: CSV_REPORT_PREFIX
env.description: Where error reports are written. Must be disjoint from CSV_PREFIX, or reports retrigger the importer.

env.name: CSV_MAX_BYTES
env.description: Largest file to import. Read whole, so this bounds memory.

env.name: CSV_ABORT_ON_ERROR
env.description: Abort the whole import on the first bad row instead of applying the good ones.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Required by §5. Finds uploads the trigger missed and resets imports stuck mid-run.

operations.title: POST /reconcile
operations.description: Cron. Missed uploads and stuck imports.

operations.title: GET /imports/:id
operations.description: Import status plus its row errors.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
